name: ContactCursorRow
doc: Predefined type returned by the fetch operation over the contacts system cursor.

fields.name: agentName
fields.doc: Name of the agent assigned to the contact.

fields.name: handlingAgentName
fields.doc: Name of the agent that handled the interaction.

fields.name: moment
fields.doc: Moment after which the contact can be made.

fields.name: loadable
fields.doc: True if the contact is not locked and the agent can load the contact.

fields.name: forcePowerDial
fields.doc: If true, the Altitude uCI Server always makes power dial calls to the contact to ensure that an agent is available to talk to the contact.

fields.name: manualScheduleTimeLimit
fields.doc: Latest time of day to call the contact after a manual reschedule.

fields.name: manualScheduleMoment
fields.doc: Moment after which the contact can be made, after a manual reschedule.

fields.name: skillProfile
fields.doc: Skill profile required by the contact.

fields.name: ignoreDoNotCallList
fields.doc: If true, the Altitude uCI Server does not check if the contact phone numbers belong to a DNCL before calling the contact.

fields.name: reschedulePhone
fields.doc: Contact phone number for manual scheduled calls.

fields.name: reschedulePhoneScheduleRule
fields.doc: Name of the schedule rule for the reschedule phone.

fields.name: directoryName
fields.doc: Directory of the contact profile of the contact.

fields.name: contactProfileRecord
fields.doc: Contact profile record of the contact.

name: ContactProfileCursorRow
doc: Predefined type returned by the fetch operation over the contactProfiles system cursor.

fields.name: contactProfileRecord
fields.doc: Contact profile record of the contact.

name: ContactProfileInteractionHistoryCursorRow
doc: Predefined type returned by the fetch operation over the contactProfileInteractionsHistory and contactProfileInteractionsWithOutcomesHistory system cursors.

fields.name: mediaDisplayName
fields.doc: User-friendly name of the media type.

fields.name: interactionThreadDuration
fields.doc: Duration of the interaction thread, in seconds.

fields.name: interactionThreadRecorded
fields.doc: True if the interaction thread was recorded.

fields.name: scriptSessionDuration
fields.doc: Duration of the script session, in seconds.

fields.name: scriptSessionRecorded
fields.doc: True if the script session was recorded.

fields.name: to
fields.doc: Interaction destination. The to recipients cannot exceed 4000 characters.

fields.name: wrapUpDuration
fields.doc: Duration of the wrap-up of the interaction.

fields.name: businessSegment
fields.doc: The business segment of the interaction.

fields.name: contactList
fields.doc: The contact list of the interaction.

fields.name: skillProfile
fields.doc: The required skill profile of the interaction.

fields.name: outcomeId
fields.doc: Id of the activity outcome. Only for the cursor contactProfileInteractionsWithOutcomesHistory.

fields.name: trunkLine
fields.doc: For telephony interactions, the name of the trunk line.

name: ContactProfileQueuedEmailCursorRow
doc: Predefined type returned by the fetch operation over the contactProfileQueuedEmails system cursor.

fields.name: interactionId
fields.doc: Identifier of the email interaction on the queue, used by the action pick up email interaction.

fields.name: agentName
fields.doc: Name of the agent that handles the interaction.

fields.name: agentFullName
fields.doc: Full name of the agent that handles the interaction.

fields.name: moment
fields.doc: Date and time of the beginning of the interaction.

fields.name: canPickUp
fields.doc: True if the email is queued for manual pick-up.

fields.name: mediaDisplayName
fields.doc: User-friendly name of the media type.

fields.name: handlingAgentName
fields.doc: If the email is currently being handled, name of the agent currently handling the email.

fields.name: anonymous
fields.doc: True if the email relates to an anonymous campaign.

name: ContactProfileInProgressWorkflowProcessTasksCursorRow
doc: Predefined type returned by the fetch operation over thecontactProfileInProgressWorkflowProcessTasks system cursor.

fields.name: taskId
fields.doc: Identifier of the workflow task on the queue, used by the action pick up workflow task.

fields.name: processDefinitionName
fields.doc: Name of the workflow definition of the workflow task.

fields.name: processUniqueId
fields.doc: Identifier of the workflow process of the workflow task.

fields.name: priorityClass
fields.doc: Priority class of the workflow process.

fields.name: agentName
fields.doc: Name of the agent that handled or will handle the workflow task.

fields.name: agentFullName
fields.doc: Full name of the agent that handled or will handle the workflow task.

fields.name: campaignName
fields.doc: Name of the campaign of the workflow task.

fields.name: canPickUp
fields.doc: True if the workflow task is queued for manual pick-up.

name: InteractionThreadHistoryCursorRow

fields.name: addressType
fields.doc: Type of address to reach the customer.

fields.name: mediaDisplayName
fields.doc: User-friendly name of the media type.

fields.name: duration
fields.doc: Duration of the interaction thread in seconds.

fields.name: recorded
fields.doc: True if the interaction thread was recorded.

fields.name: to
fields.doc: Interaction destination. The to recipients cannot exceed 4000 characters.

fields.name: processUniqueId
fields.doc: Unique identifier of the workflow process of the current interaction.

fields.name: wrapUpDuration
fields.doc: Duration of the wrap-up of the interaction.

fields.name: businessSegment
fields.doc: The business segment of the interaction.

fields.name: contactList
fields.doc: The contact list of the interaction.

fields.name: skillProfile
fields.doc: The required skill profile of the interaction.

doc: Predefined type representing personal information about a customer. For example, the name, job information, home and work addresses, and telephone numbers.
